premises.text: Customer service is widely poor across airlines, hotels, retail, restaurants, and similar
premises.evidence_span: Customer service sucks. You all know this. You've seen it on airlines, at hotels, at retail, at restaurants

premises.text: Consumers rate individual service interactions on phone in ~30 seconds with comments and social share
premises.evidence_span: empower people to rate customer service on their cell phones

premises.text: Ratings help shoppers choose which salesperson/provider to deal with before an interaction
premises.evidence_span: before you went down to the car dealership, you could find out something about the people who are selling you the product

premises.text: Negative ratings can request a business response; feedback reaches employee and manager
premises.evidence_span: we could even request a response from Oceanic Airlines

premises.text: Business dashboard aggregates ratings, peer comparisons, employee performance, and response inbox
premises.evidence_span: we will provide a portal, essentially, a dashboard for businesses where they can go in and at a glance see what's going on with their business

premises.text: Distribution via app stores, social, location-app integrations, and partner promotion (buttons/signs)
premises.evidence_span: they will actually promote Tello to their customers and have either buttons they wear or signs at the point of sale

value.text: Raise the bar on customer service by shining a bright light via public ratings
value.evidence_span: by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better

causal_links.evidence_span: in 30 seconds or less, you just provided not only that employee, but also their manager with information
compare themselves against other businesses on customer service

notes: Thumbs up/down/comment/Facebook/Twitter demo cascade folded into rating mechanism (§4.1.7). Pre-visit salesperson choice kept as distinct consumer discovery job. 14M businesses and investor credentials excluded as traction/credentials (§4.2). Free consumer app HTML5/Android roadmap folded into distribution. Anti-template: problem, consumer product, business+GTM separately revisable.
